verdict.rationale: Fin's integrations page says it "works through MCP or API Data Connectors for your business tools," and a help article covers connecting the Zapier MCP connector to Fin. Together these show Fin acting as an MCP client that uses external tools. The Intercom MCP server docs cover the opposite, server-side role and are not credited here. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on adding arbitrary or custom MCP servers (configuration, auth, tool selection and permissions), evidence beyond the Zapier connector, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
